warning.titlePre: Jaguar XK8 Timing Chain Tensioner Wear
paragraphs: If your XK8 is a first-generation (X100) model from 1996 to 2006 with the AJ26 or AJ27 V8 — that's the entire production run for the XK8 — timing chain tensioner wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, established in Jaguar specialist circles. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, and guides as standard on every X100 V8 rebuild.
The later X150 generation uses a different engine (AJ-V8 Gen III), which doesn't share this specific issue.
warning.source: Source: established pattern in Jaguar specialist circles (per G-BRF and VRF).
